children: UAE-based Lamprell has signed an agreement with International Maritime Industries (IMI), a full-service shipyard in the MENA region, to fabricate several offshore structures, including production platforms and jackets.
Under the agreement, fabrication will take place at IMI’s Ras Al-Khair facility in Saudi Arabia, the engineering, procurement, construction and installation (EPCI) contractor said in a statement.
This is the first offshore fabrication scope for production platforms and jackets at the IMI facility.
Lamprell also has facilities in Saudi Arabia through its joint venture partnership with IMI.
IMI is a joint venture between Saudi Aramco, Lamprell, Bahri and Hyundai Heavy Industries.

title: Lamprell signs deal to fabricate offshore structures in Saudi Arabia
